rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Their pairs” may mean like idol worshippers grouped with idol worshippers and star worshippers with star worshippers, male and female wrongdoers together, or their devil companions.
rows.anchor: Eşleriyle yani emsâl emsâle: Puta tapanı puta tapanla, yıldıza tapanı yıldıza tapanla

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the path to Hell as the bridge of Hell.
rows.anchor: Toplayın da götürün onları sırâta; cehennem köprüsüne doğru

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Coming from the right means approaching from a sound side, as a well-wisher and in a good manner.
rows.anchor: Bize sağdan gelirdiniz sağdan gelmek sağlam taraftan, iyi ve hayırhah bir surette gelmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised provision is known and assured in its continuity, taste, and other qualities.
rows.anchor: devamı, lezzeti gibi hasâisi mâlum ve mukarrer

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the provision fruits signals that the people of Paradise eat and drink purely for pleasure, since fruit is eaten just for delight.
rows.anchor: bu tâbirde iki nükte vardır. Birisi, ehl-i cennetin yemeleri içmeleri mahza zevk u lezzet için olduğunu ihtardır. Çünkü meyve sade lezzet için yenir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fruits also indicate that the delights of Paradise are the yield of worldly endeavors.
rows.anchor: Diğeri de dünyadaki mesâînin semerâtı olmasına işarettir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Gardens of bliss” are gardens consisting of nothing but bliss.
rows.anchor: Na‘îm cennetleri nimetten başka bir şey olmayan cennetler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A ka's is a cup filled with drink; an empty cup is not called ka's.
rows.anchor: ke’s dolu kadeh, boşuna “ke’s” denmez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ma'in means water flowing from its spring or flowing visibly before the eye, and describes the drink of Paradise.
rows.anchor: Ma‘în” aslında menba‘ından çıkan, yahut göz önünde akan su demek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink has none of the hangover, harm, or sin associated with worldly wine.
rows.anchor: onda hiçbir gāile yok dünya şarapları gibi humârı, mazarratı, günahı yok

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who drink it are not made drunk.
rows.anchor: ve ondan sarhoş da edilmezler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The women restrain their glances for their spouses and look at no one else.
rows.anchor: Gamzelerini zevclerine kasretmiş, başkasına bakmaz dilberler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A qarin is a companion who stayed with the speaker in the world.
rows.anchor: Benim bir karînim vardı yani dünyada beraberimde duran bir arkadaş.

rows.speaker: Buhârî
rows.claim: Bukhari interprets the qarin as Satan.
rows.anchor: Buhârî’de bu karîn, şeytan [4055] diye tefsir edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the question as asking whether they will really be punished after death and becoming dust and bones.
rows.anchor: Öldüğümüz ve bir toprakla bir yığın kemik olduğumuz vakit hakikaten biz cezâlanacak mıyız?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nuzul is the hospitality offered to a guest as soon as the guest arrives.
rows.anchor: “Nüzül”[^4] misafir gelir gelmez ikram için sunulan konukluk.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling Paradise's present delights nuzul shows they are only an initial welcome gift; greater blessings lie beyond present understanding.
rows.anchor: öyle nimetler vardır ki şimdi zihinler onu anlamaktan âcizdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By analogy, the Zaqqum tree is the hospitality set out for Hell's people.
rows.anchor: İşte ehl-i cehennem için de {شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ} zakkum ağacı öyledir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zaqqum is named for a small-leaved tree of Tihama that is bitter and foul-smelling.
rows.anchor: “Zakkūm” Tihâme’de biten küçük yapraklı acı ve fena kokar bir ağacın ismi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree is a trial because wrongdoers are enamored and afflicted by it in this world, then suffer its torment in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: Ona dünyada zâlimler meftun ve mübtelâ olur. Âhirette de mihnet ve azâbını çekerler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also alludes to oppressive institutions established to consume people's wealth through injustice as the wrongdoers' own institution.
rows.anchor: halkı zulüm ile yemek için kurulan zaleme teşkîlâtı o zâlimler kurumu.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree grows at Hell's root or bottom, and its branches spread through the levels of Hell.
rows.anchor: O cehennemin kökünde, dibinde çıkar da dalları derekâtına dağılır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tal' means the points where the fruit emerges.
rows.anchor: Tal‘ı, meyvesinin doğum noktaları

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation takes the devils' heads as an imagined simile for extreme ugliness.
rows.anchor: Son derece çirkinlikten kinaye olmak üzere muhayyel bir teşbih.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation says shayatin are terrifying snakes with ugly faces.
rows.anchor: “Şeyâtîn” çirkin suratlı korkunç yılanlar demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A third interpretation identifies the devils' heads with the fruit of a famously ugly plant called “asten” in Yemen.
rows.anchor: “Ruûsü’ş-şeyâtîn” çirkin manzaralı mâruf bir otun meyvesi imiş ki Yemen’de “esten” denilirmiş.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He proposes a fourth sense: the tree's alluring blossoms and fruiting points, which look like sources of income, deceive and captivate wrongdoers like devils' heads or chiefs.
rows.anchor: Vâridât menba‘ları gibi [4056] görünen o noktalar öyle iğfalkârdır ki sanki şeytanların başları yahut rüesâsı gibi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shawb means an additive mixed into a drink, a mixture, or a boiling infusion.
rows.anchor: “Şevb” içkiye karıştırılan katkı, aşlama veya haşlama.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hamim is boiling water, specifically Hell's water that tears apart the intestines.
rows.anchor: “Hamîm” esasen kaynar su demek olup cehennemin[^6] em‘âyı parçalayan suyuna denir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink mixed with it is gassaq, pus or flowing wound discharge; the wrongdoers who brought people to this state will themselves be scalded this way.
rows.anchor: Bununla haşlanan o içki de “gassâk”, akan cerahat, irindir. Çünkü zâlimler halkı bu hâle getirirler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-kitab al-mustabin means the clear Book, or a well-expressed Book with clear exposition: the Torah.
rows.anchor: Belli kitap, yahut beyânı, ifadesi güzel kitap, yani Tevrat.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ilyas is among the messengers sent to warn, a prophet of the Children of Israel; he is said to be Ilyas b. Yasin and a descendant of Aaron.
rows.anchor: o da Benî İsrâil peygamberlerinden (İlyas b. Yâsîn) ki Hârûn aleyhisselâm’ın ahfâdından denilmiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı prays to be among the servants who attain this praise.
rows.anchor: Ya Rab, bizi de bu hamde eren kullarından eyle.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those around the Throne are the angels encircling it, whose immense number is known only to God; he links this description to 39:75.
rows.anchor: Arş’ın etrafını donatan melekler ki bunlar çok, pek çoktur, adetlerini ancak Allah bilir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kerubiyyun is the plural of kerubi, pronounced with a fatḥa on kaf, ḍamma on ra, and light ra; doubling the ra is technically wrong despite being widespread.
rows.anchor: Bunlara “Kerûbiyyûn” derler ki kâf’ın fethi râ’nın zammı ve tahfîfiyle “kerûbî”nin cem‘idir. Teşdid hatadır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kerub comes from kerb in the sense of nearness, on the fa'ul pattern, and means the angels closest to God.
rows.anchor: “Kerûb” kurb mânasına “kerb”den fe‘ûldür. Allah’a en yakın olan melekler demek olur.

rows.speaker: some
rows.claim: Some say Kerubiyyun refers only to the bearers of the Throne.
rows.anchor: Onun için bazıları Kerûbiyyûn yalnız Hamele-i Arş’tır demişler

rows.speaker: İbn Sînâ
rows.claim: Ibn Sina describes Kerubiyyun as commanders of the highest heavenly realm and its arenas.
rows.anchor: İbn Sînâ da Melâike risalesinde şöyle demiştir: “Melâike-i kerûbiyyûn tîh-i a‘lâ arasâtının âmirleri

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels described above believe in their Lord through praise and glorification and pray for forgiveness on behalf of believers.
rows.anchor: İşte bütün bunlar tesbih ve tahmid ile Rablerine iman etmişler ve mü’minler için öyle istiğfar ve dua[^4] ederler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers addressed are those who disputed God's signs and were described as destined for the Fire; the passage describes their state after entering Hell.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın âyâtında mücadele eden ve[^1] ashâb-ı nâr oldukları beyan buyurulan kâfirlerin cehenneme girdikten sonraki hâlleri anlatılıyor:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's wardens in Hell will shout to the disbelievers.
rows.anchor: Onlara şöyle bağırılacak[^2] Allah tarafından cehennemde zebânîler bağıracaklar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Makt means intense hatred.
rows.anchor: “makt” buğzun şiddetlisi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One cause of the disbelievers' self-hatred is that, after seeing Resurrection, Paradise, and Hell, they regret persisting in denial.
rows.anchor: kıyameti, cenneti[^6] ve cehennemi gördükleri zaman bunları inkârda ısrar ettiklerinden dolayı nefislerine kızacaklar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Followers will hate their leaders.
rows.anchor: sonra tâbi‘olanlar metbû‘ları olan rüesâya kızacaklar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will also hate themselves when Iblis tells them that he only invited them and they followed, so they should blame themselves rather than him.
rows.anchor: İblis kendilerine nutuk îrad edip “benim sizin üzerinizde bir saltanatım yoktu, yalnız sizi davet ettim de beni dinlediniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two deaths and two revivals indicate death after worldly life, revival in the grave, another death, and resurrection; on this reading, the world's life is not counted because they had denied their sins there.
rows.anchor: birinci öldürme dünyâ hayâtı bitiren ilk ölüm, ikinci öldürme kabirdeki birinci ihyâyı tâkip eden ölüm, ikinci ihyâ da ba‘s; şu hâlde dünyâ hayat kāle alınmamıştır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This sequence is used to infer the punishment of the grave.
rows.anchor: Buradan azâb-ı kabre istidlâl edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers in Saffat say they will experience only their first death, while the righteous in ad-Dukhan will taste only the first death; these passages provide a comparison with the disbelievers' two deaths.
rows.anchor: Buna mukabil mü’minler Sûre-i Sâffât’ta أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ [37/58-59] demişlerdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the first pair may concern bodily death and life and the second spiritual death and life, suggesting that the believer's soul remains directly in existence.
rows.anchor: bunlardan birincinin bedene ait ölüm ve hayat, ikincinin de rûha ait ölüm ve hayat diye mülâhaza edilmesi

rows.speaker: some
rows.claim: Some take the duals as mere repetition or intensification, like the repeated glance in al-Mulk 67:4: the disbelievers say they were repeatedly killed and revived, thereby recognizing God's power and the possibility of return.
rows.anchor: tesniyesi gibi mahza tekrar ve teksir maksadına haml edenler de olmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their confession means they have now admitted, recognized, and understood their sins.
rows.anchor: şimdi günahlarımızı itiraf ettik, tanıdık anladık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their question about an exit may mean return to the world, going elsewhere, or dying again; they either despair or suggest that God could provide a way if He wished.
rows.anchor: Bu ateşten gerek dünyaya dönmek ve gerek başka bir yere gitmek, yahut bir daha ölmek gibi herhangi bir suretle olursa olsun bir çıkmaya yol var mı?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their punishment follows because they rejected the call to worship God alone but believed when partners were associated with Him; those partners have passed away and hold no authority, so judgment belongs to God.
rows.anchor: de O’na şirk koşulursa iman ediyordunuz o şirk koşulanların hepsi fâni olup gittikleri, hiçbirinin hükmü olmadığı için

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is exalted in essence, attributes, and acts, with nothing like Him, and worship belongs to Him alone.
rows.anchor: O ulu, büyük Allah’ın gāyet-i ulüv ve kibriyâ ile muttasıf; zâtında, sıfâtında ve [4150] ef‘âlinde لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌۭ [eş-Şûrâ 42/11][^12] olup mâbudluk yalnız kendinin hakkı bulunan Allah’ın.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has decreed the disbelievers' everlasting punishment; escape from His ruling is impossible, and He does not forgive associating partners with Him.
rows.anchor: İşte O size ebedî azâbı hükmetti.[^14] O’nun hükmünden kurtuluşa imkan yoktur, müşriklere buğzu büyüktür, şirke mağfiret etmez.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God shows people signs of His unique divinity and greatness and sends rain as bodily provision and knowledge and Qur'an as spiritual provision.
rows.anchor: ulûhiyette teferrüdünü ve azametini anlatan âyâtını gösteriyor, onunla beraber وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ{}رِزْقًۭا ve sizin için semâdan bir rızık da indiriyor yani cismânî rızkınıza sebep olan yağmur, mânevî rızkınıza sebep olan ilim ve Kur’an indiriyor.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only those who turn to God understand the signs; he urges people to turn their hearts and reflect.
rows.anchor: o âyetleri herkes anlamaz, ancak inâbe eden, gönül veren düşünen anlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers should worship and call upon God with sincere religion despite the disbelievers' displeasure.
rows.anchor: Allah’a dini ihlâs ederek ibadet ve dua edin ey mü’minler! İsterse o[^16] kâfirler hoşlanmasınlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rafiʿ al-darajat can mean that the degrees granted to angels and beloved servants are lofty, or that God raises degrees.
rows.anchor: Dereceleri çok yüksek meleklere ve sevdiği kullarına bahşeylediği dereceler çok yüksek, yahut dereceleri yükselten

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God, possessor of the Throne, sends an angel and revelation from His command to whom He wills among His servants to warn them of the frightening Day of Meeting.
rows.anchor: kullarından dilediği kimseye emrinden rûh ilkā buyuruyor yani melek indirip vahiy veriyor لِيُنذِرَ{}يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ o telâkī gününü inzar etmek için. Onun korkunçluğunu haber vermek için.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Meeting is Resurrection, when spirits and bodies, inhabitants of heaven and earth, deeds and doers, and worshipped beings and worshippers meet or clash.
rows.anchor: “Telâkī Günü” kıyamet günüdür. Zira o gün rûhlar ve cisimler, göktekiler ve yerdekiler, ameller ve âmiller, mâbudlar ve âbidler telâkī edecekler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day people emerge from their graves and stand exposed; nothing of themselves, their deeds, or their states is hidden from God.
rows.anchor: o gün ki o halk hep burûz etmişler, kabirlerden[^17] çıkmış, açığa fırlamışlardır. Nefislerini örten, amellerini gizleyen hiçbir şey kalmamış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wahid means God cannot admit any partner or plurality in His essence; He has neither parts nor constituent units.
rows.anchor: “Vâhid” zâtında hiç şirkete, kesrete ihtimâli yok; eczâsı da yok, cüz’iyyâtı da yok.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qahhar means everything is subject to God's overpowering; all perishes except His face, and He is sovereign to do what He wills.
rows.anchor: “Kahhâr” bir şerîki olmak şöyle dursun her şey O’nun kahrına mahkum; كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that each soul is recompensed for what it earned explains the effects of God's sovereignty and overpowering.
rows.anchor: Mülk ve kahrın eserini beyandır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Azife can mean an approaching calamity, the hour of death, the Resurrection hour that makes death seem preferable, or the painful moment of judgment and entry into Hell.
rows.anchor: “Âzife” yaklaşmakta olan felâket, ölüm saati, yahut ölümü aratan o kıyamet saati, yahut hesap görülüp cezâ kesilip de cehenneme girilmek üzere bulunulduğu saat

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God judges with truth, fully carries out His judgment, and makes the truth prevail.
rows.anchor: Hem Allah hakkı kazâ buyurur hak ile hükmeder ve hükmünü tamamen icrâ eyler, hakkı ihkāk eyler, yerine getirir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those invoked besides God, whether lifeless idols or others, cannot independently decree or execute anything because they are subdued under His judgment.
rows.anchor: kendiliklerinden hiçbir şeye kat‘iyyetle hüküm verip tamamıyla icrâ ve infaz edemezler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God hears and sees perfectly; those who cannot hear and see rightly cannot establish and execute the truth or judge.
rows.anchor: çünkü Allah’tır ancak hakkıyla işiten, gören iyi işitip görmeyen ise hakkı yerine getiremez, kādî olamaz.
